updates.detailed_summary_zh:
OpenSea 已在其市场上启用基于 Solana 的 NFT 的购买、出售和交易，距其初始测试版已四年多。用户现在可以在该平台访问 Solana 数字收藏品。

此举拓宽了 OpenSea 的跨链覆盖面，使基于 Solana 的 NFT 项目能够触达最大的 NFT 市场之一。这可能提升 Solana 收藏品的流动性和知名度，并表明 NFT 生态持续走向多链采用。

此次上线发生在 OpenSea 最初推出 Solana 测试版四年多之后。Solana 采用权益证明共识，据 Blockchain.com 称其理论上最高可处理每秒 65,000 笔交易，不过该网络也曾经历宕机并受到美国证券交易委员会审查。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
OpenSea has enabled buying, selling, and trading of Solana-based NFTs on its marketplace, more than four years after its initial beta. Users can now access Solana digital collectibles alongside existing listings on the platform.

This broadens OpenSea's cross-chain reach and gives Solana-based NFT projects access to one of the largest NFT marketplaces. It could increase liquidity and awareness for Solana collectibles and signal continued multi-chain adoption in the NFT ecosystem.

The launch arrives more than four years after OpenSea's initial Solana beta. Solana uses a proof-of-stake consensus and, according to Blockchain.com, can theoretically process up to 65,000 transactions per second, though the network has also experienced outages and SEC scrutiny.
updates.background_zh: OpenSea 是最大的 NFT 市场之一，早期 NFT 交易大多发生在以太坊区块链上。Solana 由 Solana Labs 于 2020 年推出，以更快、更便宜的优势在 NFT 和去中心化应用领域获得关注。新增 Solana 支持让 OpenSea 用户能够进入以太坊之外的重要 NFT 生态。
updates.background_en: OpenSea is one of the largest NFT marketplaces, and most early NFT trading occurred on the Ethereum blockchain. Solana, launched by Solana Labs in 2020, gained traction as a faster and cheaper alternative for NFTs and decentralized applications. Adding Solana support lets OpenSea users tap into a major NFT ecosystem outside Ethereum.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次整合使基于 Solana 的数字收藏品能够触达 OpenSea 的庞大用户群，可能增加链上活动以及对用于支付网络费用的 SOL 的需求。传导渠道主要是围绕 Solana NFT 生态的交易活跃度和市场情绪，而非 Solana 基本面发生变化。
updates.market_impact_en: The integration exposes Solana-based digital collectibles to OpenSea's large user base, potentially increasing on-chain activity and demand for SOL, which is required to pay network fees. The transmission channel is primarily trading activity and sentiment around Solana's NFT ecosystem, rather than any change to Solana's fundamentals.
